Memorandum To:
Mayor McClellan called the Special Called Meeting of the Council to order at 5:30P.M.,
noting the presence of all members, and announced that Council will convene in a closed or
executive session authorized by Section 2, Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article 6252-17,
Texas Revised Civil Statutes annotated; and after such closed or executive session, any
final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter considered in the closed or
executive session will be made in open session, should such action, decision or vote be
necessary.
